Transcriptomic Classification using Mixture of Normal Distributions with splitTypeR

The splitTypeR package provides an automated statistical framework to classify heterogeneous biological samples based on gene signature lists, effectively isolating the signature-positive samples. This classification method is designed for bulk transcriptomic datasets.

Citing

If you use this package for a publication, we would ask you to cite the following:

Deschênes A, Belleau P, Tuveson DA (2026). splitTypeR: Transcriptomic Classification using Mixture of Normal Distributions. R package version 0.99.9, https://github.com/adeschen/splitTypeR.
